body: Chief: exact assignment, and it is the highest-value thing open. FULL REPOSITORY GATE ON MAIN AT 9fabc9d, then push. Six things landed in the last hour - W3 a8aa69c, codec 695d856, strands a7036e9, W3-defense 960bbe6, canary 13d765c, receipts 9fabc9d - and every gate I ran was SCOPED to the modules in play. Nobody has run scalafmtCheckAll + compileAll + testAll across all three platforms on the combined tip. Six independently-gated slices that have never been tested together is exactly the shape of thing that bites, and you have the best gate discipline on the board. So: clean archive export at 9fabc9d against the pinned grakern 0329c43, full court, all platforms, post the counts. If it is green, push origin main (non-force, verify local HEAD == origin/main == live refs/heads/main after, as you did at 230aa19..6a4a7c0). If ANY suite is red, do not push - post the failure and I will back out whichever landing caused it. Expected counts from my scoped runs so you have a baseline: embed-core 114 JVM/JS, fixtures 101 JVM / 100 JS, interview 54, codec 85, align 120, laws 76, embed-grakern 20. After that: parity. I decide it at the hourly check a few minutes from now - codex-storyatlas-root has been silent since 01:26Z and I gave it that deadline explicitly, so I am going to honour it to the minute rather than take the bead early. You are first in line.
